artworks.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished individual landscape artwork for a Runtime Hosting product card on a clean modern developer website. Generate only the artwork, no website or card mockup. Wide 16:9 composition, ideally 1792x1024 or similar landscape.
Primary request: a premium, exceptionally polished 3D studio illustration of ONE dedicated Discord bot hosting runtime. Consistent series art direction: a single small beautifully engineered white ceramic and satin aluminum server appliance with rounded edges, three horizontal dark inset ventilation slots and tiny accent status LEDs, alongside one friendly tiny floating bot head with a dark glass face, two luminous square eyes, no limbs. These are the only main objects. The floating head represents the bot, the appliance its hosting slot.
Scene: airy near-white studio with a very pale accent-tinted gradient, soft floor, tactile diffuse shadows, restrained translucent glass ring behind the central objects symbolizing time, subtle fine orbital strokes. Accent color used only as highlights on the glass ring, LEDs, and soft reflected light. Crisp physical materials, subtle texture, premium editorial product rendering, balanced ample breathing room, no excessive bloom.
Composition: sophisticated horizontal layout with bold dark charcoal typography on left occupying 38% of image, centered 3D server and small bot on right occupying 50%. Title must be bold geometric sans serif and extremely legible at thumbnail size. Small uppercase eyebrow reads exactly "RUNTIME HOSTING". Large title below reads exactly "1 WEEK". Under title a restrained small label reads exactly "7 DAYS". Keep all text and main objects safely within central 80% of canvas for cropping. Keep top-left 15% image clear of text or objects because website has an overlay badge there. Put eyebrow around x10%, y37%, large title around x10%, y49%, small label x10%, y66%. No other text.
Constraints: one hosting appliance and one bot in each artwork; do not imply additional hosting slots, extra hardware, tiers of compute, different performance, uptime guarantee, prices, or features. No Discord logo, no brand logos, no watermarks, no framing, no rounded outer card border, no CTA. Avoid generic neon cyberpunk and visual clutter. Professional matching set, exact same object design and camera angle each time.
Variant: accent palette electric blue #2979ff and cyan; one elegant thin blue orbital arc, subtle seven tick marks.
